request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT

layers.text: Zoom in to a close-up portrait: redraw it as only the head and the top of the shoulders, twice as big, filling the image. A big round head with a pale cream-green face, colour #cde0b4, framed by shaggy olive green mossy hair and a mossy olive beard, a big nose, tiny eyes, two cream tusks, pale cream-green bare shoulders, no helmet and no spike. Keep the thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
